scripture.verse: "And on the Sabbath we went out of the city by a riverside, whereprayer was customarily made; and we sat down and spoke to the women who met there. And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, who worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul."
"That signs and wonders may be done by the name of Your holy Child, Jesus."
"I am Alpha and Omega, the Beginning and the End, the First and the Last."

sermons.title: Sermon 547 | Suffering And Reigning With Jesus

scripture.verse: "If we suffer, we shall also reign with Him: if we deny Him, He also will deny us."
"And the Lord said unto Moses, Why cry you unto Me? Speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward."

sermons.title: Sermon 549 | A Desperate Case—How to Meet It

scripture.verse: "Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out? And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove: and nothing shall be impossible unto you. Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting."

sermons.title: Sermon 550 | The Ship on Fire—a Voice of Warning

scripture.verse: "Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ; grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord, according as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue: whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust."
